purpose: Pass 07 adds founder-console page composition, HUD panel composition, build-session list view, review queue read route, validation report list view, and pass-validator registry.
authorityBoundaries: Founder console page is read-only and informational.
HUD panel composer only orders display panels and does not execute actions.
Build-session list view exposes safe summaries only.
Review queue read route does not approve, return, or block items.
Validation report list view displays report metadata only.
Pass-validator registry records validator paths and does not run them by itself.
Jarvis remains under Kingsmen doctrine, backend state machine, validators, evidence, and founder approval.
knownGaps: package.json aggregate validator wiring remains deferred because previous broad package rewrites were blocked.
Pass 07 modules are directly importable by path until a safe export index is added.
